rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides direct integration with Google Cloud Compliance Manager, enabling discovery, deployment, and management of compliance frameworks like CIS, NIST, and FedRAMP across Google Cloud organizations, folders, and projects. Built by Varun Bhardwaj using the FastMCP framework, it offers tools for listing available frameworks and cloud controls, creating and monitoring framework deployments, and tracking compliance posture through both detective and preventive enforcement modes. The implementation is particularly valuable for security teams managing enterprise compliance requirements, automating compliance deployment workflows, and conducting regular compliance audits across large Google Cloud infrastructures.
